sources.title: momosuzu nene (1st costume)
sources.excerpt:
It consists of a [[orange shirt|orange]] [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[frilled shirt]] with cutouts on her [[cleavage cutout|cleavage]] and [[cutout above navel|above her navel]], a [[bodice]] or [[underbust]] [[corset]], [[short sleeves|short]] [[detached sleeves]] or [[arm garter]]s, a [[multicolored bowtie]] with a [[peach ornament|peach-shaped]] [[neck bell|neck]] [[jingle bell]], a [[frilled skirt|frilled]] [[layered skirt|layered]] [[orange skirt|orange]] and [[yellow skirt]] [[miniskirt]] [[skirt set|set]] (although her costume is often depicted as a dress sometimes), a white [[petticoat]] with [[dress flower|flowers]] on it a [[large bow|large]] [[back bow]], a [[bear bag|bear]] [[handbag]], a [[single thighhigh|single]] [[frilled thighhighs|frilled]] [[white thighhighs|white thighhigh]] and a [[single sock|single]] [[frilled socks|frilled]] [[white socks|white sock]] worn [[uneven legwear|unevenly]], and [[brown boots]]. Her hair buns can turn into [[bear ears]], and she can add [[bear paws|bear]] [[paw gloves]], and a [[white jacket|white]] [[letterman jacket]].

h4. Appearance

* !post #4334349: Profil
